checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Slides read Slow Sunday, Coffee first., Stay a little longer. (trailing periods added on two).
Cream backgrounds, brown serif text and illustrations; slide 1 is softer/more painterly but cohesive.
Cup on table, pour-over kettle and mug, armchair with coffee and book.
All text is clear and well within the edges.

faults.what: Slides 2 and 3 add a trailing period not in the requested text; slide 1 has none, so punctuation is inconsistent.
Slide 1 style (soft painterly, text left, window) differs somewhat from the flat line-art slides 2 and 3; text sizes and placement vary.
Slide 2 hand holding the kettle is a sketchy thin outline and a bit odd; a stray splash mark appears by the cup.

summary: Three clean square cream-and-brown café slides with correct readable text and fitting illustrations; minor issues are added periods, slide 1's slightly different style, and a sketchy hand on slide 2.
